lines.text: Elihu says the Spirit of God made him and that he was also formed from clay.
Elihu quotes Job saying God counts him as His enemy and puts his feet in the stocks.
God opens men's ears with warnings in a dream at night to keep them from wealth.
A mediator in a thousand says he has found the man's ransom, and the man's flesh is refreshed like a king's.
God does all these things to a man two or even three times to bring back his soul from the Pit.
